summary:
# CAPTAINS OF SOULS (Edgar Wallace, 1922, A.L. Burt ed.; dedicated "to Tookie")

## Characters
- **Beryl Merville**: 22, beautiful, tall, grave eyes, loves Ronnie. Engaged to Steppe. Later Mrs. Steppe.
- **Dr. Bertram Merville**: her father, retired cardiac consultant, thin, colorless, myopic, pince-nez, irritable, weak, speculator. Wife dead. Director of Steppe's companies. Lives Park Place; formerly Devonshire Street.
- **Ronald "Ronnie" Morelle**: Balliol, called to bar pre-war (never practised), journalist for Post-Herald (editor Sturgeon), director of companies, perfect looks, small brown moustache, war service in Rome (avoided front). Father Bennett Morelle, a hawker. Cousin of Merville. Valet François (German Swiss, Otto; brother in Interlaken). Flat in Knightsbridge, 3rd floor, library faces park, St Anthony painting (attributed Titian) over mantel, black oak table.
- **Ambrose Sault**: "colored" (Barbadian, lived Martinique, Noumea), gray eyes, big rough hands, huge, gray-white hair, eagle face, cannot read or write (can do figures/maths). Former convict (New Caledonia, 8 yrs 7 months) for killing a man who'd hired two men to beat him (Plassy Road hotel). Picked up by Moropulos from sea after cyclone ten miles off Isle of Pines, with three Canaques. Three war decorations (Field Ambulance, No Man's Land). Lodges with Colebrooks, 37/39 Walter Street. Healer: heals Mrs. Colebrook by touching hands, transference of identity; sews. Loved Beryl. Favorite poem Henley "Invictus" ("Out of the dark which covers me"). Rubs chin with knuckle when troubled (penal-settlement habit). Hanged at Wechester, 17 March (date on card).
- **Jan Cornelius Steppe**: financier, "Jan the third", Transvaal Boer family (grandfather byworner; father Commandant killed Tugela Drift). Black pointed beard, bristling eyebrows, bull voice, grunts "Huh", Dutch Reformed, family Bible, wax fruit. Berkeley Square (rented). Lisps none; growl.
- **Paul Dimitros Moropulos**: Greek, drunk, absinthe, beard, velvet coat (once green), house 49 Junction Terrace, Paddington ("mining engineer" in directory); cottage "The Parthenon" (Brother-of-God Farm), Hampshire. Blackmailer/information trader.
- **Christina Colebrook**: 20s, invalid (spinal), red hair, pale, reads, visionary, fantasy travels. Later walks with osteopath treatment (Dr. Duncan More, American, bearded).
- **Evie Colebrook**: pretty, petite, works at druggist/store (Knightsbridge) pay desk. Ronnie's mistress. Later engaged to Teddy Williams (Canadian, Saskatchewan, father's farm; Beaulieu).
- **Mrs. Colebrook**: mother, widow, washerwoman, superstitious, weeps, "ostymopat".
- **Sir John Maxton**: barrister, tall, slender, esthetic, executor of Bennett Morelle; defends Sault; later Scottish, hard-headed.
- **Dean**: Beryl's maid. **Parker**: Ronnie's chauffeur.
- **Lola Pranceaux**: Madame Ritti's girl (fair, golden fringe). **Madame Ritti**: stout, dyed red hair, pearls, runs Alemeda House, St John's Wood.
- **Jeremiah "Jerry" Talbot**: Ronnie's Oxford friend, sallow, bushy eyebrow, mud cosmetic. Butler Brien.
- **East** (blackmail: sister, parlourmaid, pretty girl; brother blackmailer). Mr. East later visits Ronnie.
- **Smith**: solicitor. **Inspector Lord**: Scotland Yard. **Major Boyle**: prison deputy. **Marsden**: chief warder. **Billet**: hangman. **Mr. Pinley**: prison chaplain. **Divverly**: American MD of Brakfontein mine.

---

## BOOK THE FIRST

**I.** Beryl writes Ronnie letter: back from Italy; Steppe met them at station with new car (library in locker). Met Sault in hall (shabby, shining knees, dragging laces, buttoned wrong). She feels attraction to him. Sault says "Perhaps _she_ will see me"; Dean laughs. In drawing-room Sault: from Barbados, Port de France (Martinique), Noumea. Cannot read: "A-b, ab; c-a-t, cat"; fog of letters. Pays man to read to him (Livy, Prescott, Green, Bacon). Says self-pity is mother of bitterness. Recites Henley. Dr. Merville enters, angry; takes Sault to study. Merville: Sault "anarchist/communist", dreams of "The Mother College" (raise £1m).
- Study: Moropulos worried; Brakfontein Diamond Mine (South Africa) letter from assistant manager; American managing director Divverly; manager confessed taking money from London; shares dropped 30 points; Johannesburg committee inquiry. Letters from manager in Moropulos's desk; Sault brings bundle; Merville puts in steel box. Steppe says keep them. Safe: Sault invented; "a word will open it"; wrong word → quart of acid; cut through → hollow walls fill with water → plunger destroys contents.
- Sault's origin: Moropulos's sloop (pearl smuggling); cyclone; three Canaques sentenced for cannibalism; Sault a convict; Moropulos tried to sell him at Loyalty Island. "I killed a man."

**II.** Next scene: same talk; Sault leaves. (Note: this chapter reiterates Merville's fear.)

**III.** Bank Holiday Monday, Park Lane / Row. Ronald Morelle with Evie Colebrook (shop girl, pay desk, Burts; sister Christina; mother takes in laundry; neighbourhood "full of thieves"). Evie wants marriage; Ronnie says wedding is "indelicate", love is biggest; refuses Saturday tea. Beryl rides by: Ronnie calls her "the daughter of my doctor, rather a gossip", says Evie daughter of colonel at War Office. Beryl: Ronnie writing for Sturgeon (Post-Herald), Gordon Bennett race article. Ronnie on Steppe: "nearly cleverest financier"; Moropulos drinks absinthe; Sault "nigger fellow", "half-caste", "sort of keeper". Steppe arrives in car, sits by Beryl, orders Ronnie: "Sit down", Ronnie sits. Steppe: "Interesting. A man." Steppe invites Beryl to dinner next week. Beryl sees Ronnie is afraid of Steppe.

**IV.** Walter Street kitchen. Mrs. Colebrook worries about Evie (drug store, brooding, talks in sleep). Sault's nightly visits to Christina. Christina's imagined travels (Etruria, Rome, Paris, Yang-Kuei-Fee). Christina reports Evie sleep-talks "Ronnie, take me in your car." Sault: Ronald Morelle "in Knightsbridge somewhere". Christina: Evie's shop is in Knightsbridge. Evie in at 11pm crying; "Damn my prayers". Christina: "Have you ever heard of a man called Ronald Morelle?"

**V.** Merville's finances: retired four years earlier; speculation; rubber, South African Mines; Steppe ruined/rescued him; cold storage company; East Rand Consolidated Deep (£750k, applications £2m, Merville chairman); "Investment Salvage Syndicate" (Steppe's joke). Merville's liabilities. Beryl (22). Car to dinner. Merville asks about East blackmail; Beryl says Ronnie gave East money. Merville: "Do you ever think of getting married?" Beryl: no one; Merville: "power, fortune, mental strength... Ronnie Morelle can never give".

**VI.** Dinner at Steppe's Berkeley Square (Victorian furnishings, "Sultan amidst samplers"). Guests: Maxton, Merville, Beryl. Maxton: Ronnie's executor, scribbles; Ronnie called to bar; Maxton defends Steppe's case ("disqualified winner"). Steppe eats mealies. Merville tells Sault healing story: Mrs. Colebrook (heart, "haneurism"), unconscious, Sault held her hands, she revived in under a minute; Sault went gray; then sewed a night-dress for an hour. Moropulos bursts in drunk ("Hail! Thieves and brother bandits!"), bellows; Sault removes him with a look. Maxton: "Quite an interesting evening."

**VII.** Two days later Maxton calls on Merville, interrupting Ronnie & Beryl quarrel (theatre box, Beryl saw Ronnie with a woman). Maxton: Ronnie's "friend" was Evie? Maxton and Ronnie discuss East blackmail; Maxton: "Ronnie, you are rotten." Ronnie leaves Maxton at Park Lane/Piccadilly, follows Evie into the park. Evie working late (annual stocktaking). Maxton: "Rotten!"

**VIII.** Ronnie's flat described (St Anthony/Titian painting; black oak table; Medici chair). Ronnie returns near midnight; François; Ronnie scratched by Evie (three red scratches wrist to fingers; right cheek finger-marks); screams, police. Ronnie's self-image: falcon/hawk; father a hawker. Thinks of Beryl. Sleeps; wakes at 9 o'clock church clock: "No--no--Christ--no!"; sobs.

**IX.** Moropulos in Sault's workshop: "I saw Ronnie Morelle today." Safe nearly finished; code word five letters (one Sault spelled off steerage child). Moropulos: will make list of Ronnie's love affairs. Moropulos describes Junction Terrace house and "Parthenon" cottage (plaster statues, pronaos). Steppe still angry with Moropulos. Moropulos mentions pretty young lady with Ronnie in park who "did not know his name."

**X.** Sault leaves workshop; buys biscuits for Christina; library subscription. Christina: "Sault Effendi". Beryl visits Christina (brings "Let the World Go"); Beryl's love for Ronnie revealed as self-contempt. Steppe back from Paris; gives diamond shawl pin for Beryl's birthday; Sault sends roses (father says); Beryl wears three roses.

**XI.** Evie home early; Christina/Evie talk: father "youngest son of youngest son of a lord"; family Hall; mother's line Honorable Mrs Colebrook, daughter of Lord Fanshelm. Evie says "Mr. Sault has been in prison." Christina: "Ronald Morelle--aha!" Christina: "I love his mind and his soul." Osteopath to come next day. Evie calls Sault "not sincere"; Christina angry.

**XII.** Steppe & Moropulos watch Sault demonstrate safe: five letters; flood test; rubber plug; hydrochloric acid better; notice on safe. Steppe warns Moropulos re absinthe. Steppe to "get Beryl". Sault bends iron bar into V.

**XIII.** Evie gets unsigned card from Ronnie: "Dearest girl... Your lover". Theatre with Beryl; Ronnie: "I adore you... Steppe is very keen on you"; Beryl silent; they kiss in carriage. Christina: "Why can't you sleep?" Evie: "beastly dreams".

---

## BOOK THE SECOND

**I.** Sault goes home buoyant. Mrs. Colebrook: osteopath "ostymopat" came; Christina had 10 doctors, 4 specialists. Sault tells Christina she'll walk in a year; silk smock; cost £150 (paid £100 on account; £1 a visit, daily except Sunday). Christina: "I love you as my child." Evie home: Ronnie note; Evie walks to Ronnie's; Christina: Beryl "rather runs after him". Evie: Ronnie says he's director; "I'm not very well educated".

**II.** Steppe visits Ronnie (dressing gown): Klein River Diamond flotation under press attack; engineer Mackenzie (in lunatic asylum, report forged); Steppe orders Ronnie to press criticism; Ronnie to chair meeting; Midwell Traction Corporation mentioned. Ronnie's meeting: noisy, vote of confidence; Klein Rivers rose to 17; Steppe pays "a thousand" to Ronnie. Merville has Steppe buy Howitt out; Ronnie acting chairman. Merville warns Ronnie not to unsettle Beryl. Ronnie kisses Beryl in drawing-room.

**III.** Night: Evie sobbing; "I haven't seen Ronnie for a week"; Christina: "I wish to God you'd never seen him"; Evie sleeps in Christina's bed. Christina's Australian sour-apple parable. Next morning Christina asks Sault to check Ronnie; Sault: "I can go to Morelle and warn him". Sault visits Steppe in dressing room: threat about Evie; Steppe nearly fights; Sault: "You'll not smash me"; Steppe: "I believe you about the safe". Steppe shivers at Sault. Steppe warns Ronnie at club. Ronnie remembers "The Girl Who Had Screamed" (Regent Street encounter with broad-shouldered young man). Ronnie writes to Evie: appointment.

**IV.** Park with Evie: Ronnie says he's been "working". Evie: "Sault told you"; calls Sault "nigger murderer". Christina: "Who did Ambrose kill?" Christina saw Ronnie in park with Beryl (Sault pointed him out during Kensington Gardens outing). Evie says Ronnie was writing article for The Statesman. Christina: "Ronnie is a blackguard."

**V.** Horse Show (Olympia). Steppe stops Beryl's car; tells her doctor is in financial trouble; "hundreds of thousands"; "I'm going to marry Beryl". Doctor asks Steppe to wait re call on capital (Brakpan Mines, Toledo Deeps). Steppe bought 500 shares. Beryl with Ronnie at Olympia; Ronnie takes her to dinner and revue. Doctor & Steppe go to Paris.

**VI.** Sault collects doctor's bag at Park Place; Beryl talks to him (her disgust at his negro-blood nails). Evie & Sault quarrel in kitchen; "I won't sit down at the same table as a black man." Christina: "His great grandfather was an Indian."

**VII.** Pavilion revue; Moropulos in stalls (not in evening dress). Ronnie takes Beryl to his flat for supper; she stays; they sleep together. Ronnie's friend Jerry Talbot's wine.

**VIII.** Next morning ~8am. Ronnie: "There was an Albert Hall ball last night". Beryl locks door; "Yes--Beryl--it is you!"

**IX.** Moropulos asks Sault about photographing "lady in evening dress" at 8am (kodak); Moropulos stayed outside Ronnie's all night. Beryl phones Sault 5pm; Sault comes. Beryl: "You killed somebody"; Sault describes killing; Beryl asks if he's ever loved. Sault: "I love you"; Beryl: she loves Ronnie. Sault leaves.

**X.** Ronnie regrets; writes Beryl unsigned card ("I will not see you again"); Beryl wires "Come to tea"; reply "I cannot; I dare not". Merville back from Paris (Pasteur labs); Sault didn't meet train; Steppe told Merville of Sault's threat re Evie. Beryl's dream (exchanged heads). Steppe visits Ronnie: "I am going to marry Beryl... give me a good name."

**XI.** Moropulos lunch at Soho restaurant: says he saw Beryl leave Ronnie's flat; photograph; demands Ronnie & Beryl testify he dined with them the previous night (Tuesday). Ronnie visits Beryl; asks her to lie; she refuses ("Let us be decent"); she posts letter to milliner ("Send the blue toque also").

**XII.** Christina stands; osteopath praises Sault's massage; Mrs. Colebrook "soul with hands". Evie: "we're just pals"; Evie says Ronnie "loathes" Beryl.

**XIII.** Hampstead drive: Christina, Mrs. Colebrook, Evie visit osteopath; Christina's first hat; Beryl watches from curtains. Merville tells Beryl Steppe loves her; Steppe's debts. Beryl phones Ronnie: "I can't marry him without telling him"; Ronnie pleads. Beryl "I'll think about it."

**XIV.** Moropulos's Paddington house: his blackmail network. Steppe puts envelope "The photograph" in safe. Steppe: "Sault cold... inhuman". Moropulos hates Sault. Next morning Ronnie tells Sault of Steppe's engagement (Sault "hurt" not hurt). Sault depressed; Steppe requires Sault to go with Moropulos to country. Christina: "I shall carry you with me beyond life." Christina knows (intuits).

**XV.** Friday, Brother-of-God Farm (monastery land). Sault arrives. Moropulos drunk; Sault breaks absinthe bottle; Moropulos's beard pulled; he gets revolver (ivory-handled plated). Argument; Moropulos: "I photographed her as she came out... in the safe". Sault: "You must not hurt her." Sault shoots Moropulos dead at door.

---

## BOOK THE THIRD

**I.** Sault: "I am glad." Changes into overcoat; drives car; policeman at Woking (no license). Sault to Ronnie's flat: "Dead." Ronnie denies; Sault accepts; goes to Paddington; breaks window; enters; arrested at safe by three men. Sault confesses shooting; handcuffs broken. Safe with typewritten notice pasted by Moropulos ("DON'T TURN THE HANDLE"). Sault sleeps in cell.

**II.** Sunday. Fog. Steppe at study: contents of safe (draft prospectus in Steppe's hand; letters; Mackenzie report). Ronnie visits; lies. Steppe: "Sault... that Maxton fellow." Beryl and father visit; Beryl demands safe be opened; Steppe refuses. Beryl: "I shall go into the witness box."

**III.** Christina at Beryl's house; they discuss Ambrose. Beryl admits Sault said he loved her. Mrs. Colebrook weeps. Beryl's assessment of Ronnie. Doctor sends Beryl and Steppe abroad (Cannes).

**IV.** Madame Ritti's house, Alemeda House, St John's Wood (former South American minister's). Ronnie visits; Lola; Steppe finds Ronnie with girl; Steppe bribes François; "You went to Ritti's." Steppe orders Ronnie: "Sault came"; lies.

**V.** Solicitor Smith visits Sault; Sault's maths; souls talk; "Mr. Pinley's God". Steppe's view: let Sault die; will not testify. Maxton takes brief; visits Beryl; Beryl says "Ambrose is not mad".

**VI.** Beryl & Christina; Sault's letter (prison chaplain, Gibbon, Belisarius); Maxton's report. Steppe's kiss; Beryl frightened; "Good friends, huh?"

**VII.** Doctor pressures Beryl to marry Steppe in a month. Steppe's Boer background. Maxton visits Beryl; Sault's "immortality" talk; "brains"; Ronnie's hate of Sault.

**VIII.** Ronnie's "trying the luck" Bible with Toledo sword. Evie's Teddy Williams; Evie refuses Ronnie's marriage plan; Ronnie to Palermo; Madame Ritti.

**IX.** Trial at Wechester Assizes (judge ~70). Indictment names Paul Dimitros Moropulos. Sault pleads guilty (technical not-guilty). Ronnie in court; Sault smiles at him. Verdict guilty; death sentence. Sault: "Good-bye, my friend" (Ronnie). Sir John: "Poor world... to lose a soul as great as his." Ronnie: Lola in town.

**X.** Telegram: "Sault sentenced to death. He showed splendid courage and calmness." Christina and Beryl talk; Evie goes to Ronnie's flat.

**XI.** Evie at flat with François. Ronnie: villa at Beaulieu? (Palermo). Evie "marrying me?" Ronnie: marriage is "bondage". "Try the luck": "perfect love casteth out fear" (1 John 4:18); Evie: "You made it up!"

**XII.** Doctor, Merville & Steppe at flat. Steppe's Midwell Traction bargain; Steppe reveals safe contents. Steppe: "soul" talk; Steppe's shares.

**XIII.** Beryl at flat; pleads Ronnie elope; Ronnie refuses ("I can't cross Steppe").

**XIV.** Sault's last letter from Maxton (Sault reads Gibbon; Henley). Christina's faint at 9 o'clock execution.

**XV.** Ronnie at Ritti's; wakes; drives to Wechester; prison; hangman; Sault's last walk, reciting Henley; eyes meet; soul exchange. Sault's voice/body; Ronnie hanged; "The prison clock struck nine."

---

## BOOK THE FOURTH

**I.** Ronnie (now with Sault's soul in Ronnie's body) with chaplain; cells. Kneeling man praying for Ambrose Sault. Ronnie in car; Parker; Red Lion inn; fight with groom; "learned it in New Caledonia from a Japanese". Cigarette case "To Ronnie from Beryl". Lifts Moropulos (memory).

**II.** Ronnie in flat; cries; François's letter; Mr. East visit (blackmail); Ronnie: "Get out." Ronnie cooks; reads Memorabilia; memory of Sault. Steppe & Beryl visit; Steppe mocks crying; Ronnie opens Bible: Ezekiel 24:16 ("I will take away the desire of thine eyes with a stroke"); Steppe: "You're Sault!" Steppe's code cable from Johannesburg.

**III.** Evie receives Ronnie's letter (Paris dressmakers; anchorite). Sault's room (rent prepaid). Ronnie visits Christina ("Ronnie, come to tea"); Christina's chin-rub test: Ronnie rubs chin; Christina: "Don't you know?" Water test. Christina asks "How did he die?" Ronnie: "He was so afraid!"

**IV.** Christina visits Sir John Maxton; Sault's death; "Ronald Morelle of Balliol" cry. Sir John: "Sault... explanation creditable".

**V.** Johnson & Kennett letter offering housekeeper job (Beaulieu house) for Mrs. Colebrook; invitation extended to Christina.

**VI.** Ronnie lunches with Merville & Maxton (Vivaldi's); discusses Traction prospectus; Woodside Repairing Shops; Ronnie mentions Mother College; chin-rub; Sir John asks for brandy. Ronnie's Lola and Jerry Talbot (Lola broke Talbot's head with champagne bottle; charged; Ronnie testifies Lola's innocence). Ronnie gives Lola £3,000 loan and £2,000 gift for Cornwall farm.

**VII.** Maxton to Merville: Steppe owes; Maxton asks for Christina's address. Maxton visits Christina; "Ronnie rubs his chin." Mrs. Colebrook's memorial card "In loving memory of Ambrose Sault... March 17, 19—... age fifty-three".

**VIII.** Ronnie visits Jerry Talbot (Jerry injured); Talbot's letter.

**IX.** Evie visits Ronnie; breaks; Ronnie proposes Beaulieu; Evie accepts Teddy Williams.

**X.** Beryl at Walter Street with Talbot letter; Christina drives borrowed car to Ronnie; Ronnie beats Talbot ("I may kill you"); Talbot writes retraction.

**XI.** Steppe learns Ronnie selling Klein River and Midwell shares; Ronnie refuses transfer; Ronnie tears cheque; Steppe threatens; Ronnie reveals safe's word not known. Steppe tells Ronnie Beryl to be ready.

**XII.** Inspector: warrant for Merville (Midwell Traction). Talbot's photograph report. Steppe marries Beryl at registrar, 2:30pm; "Beryl Van Steppe". Detectives outside.

**XIII.** Evie & Teddy see Beryl. Christina visits Beryl; asks her to see Ronnie at 8pm. Christina phones Ronnie.

**XIV.** Beryl leaves Maxton's dinner; Merville arrested by Inspector Lord for misrepresentation under Companies Act. Maxton goes to find Beryl and Steppe.

**XV.** Ronnie at electric radiator; memories of island prison hut. Beryl visits; "I was married today to Steppe." Steppe bursts in; Maxton; Steppe refuses to open safe; "Judas!" spelled J-U-D-A-S. Steppe: "I know you... You're Sault! They hanged you!" Steppe collapses. Beryl: "Ronnie--oh, my dear!"

**XVI.** Epilogue: Evie and Christina; Ronnie sends candy; Evie: Ronnie married Beryl within a week of Steppe's death; "soul" discussion. Last line: "Shut up!" THE END.

---
